description: Repeated unit increments stop after steps or at cap; any equivalent terminating implementation is allowed.

methods.name: Refill
methods.header:
method Refill(used: int, steps: int, cap: int) returns (next: int)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap && steps >= 0
  ensures next == (if used + steps <= cap then used + steps else cap)

mutants.violation: Unbounded increment does not stop at cap.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
